primitive.relation: the d-dimensional hypercube in two named views kept on their own carriers: Extremal XE1 xe1_hypercube and Topological D3cr hypercube (local Fixpoints Q_0 = 'K_1, Q_(d+1) = cartesian_product 'K_2 Q_d on the nested ordinal/product carrier) equal GTBase.hypercubes.product_hypercube d as graph records, by induction on d; Packing U9 hypercube (SGraph over d.-tuple bool, adjacent iff exactly one coordinate differs, with its own hc_rel/hc_sym/hc_irrefl) has the carrier and the pointwise adjacency of GTBase.hypercubes.tuple_hypercube d and the identity isomorphism to it, not an equation between opaque proof fields. The views are related for every d by the explicit isomorphism product_tuple_hypercube_diso (inverse coordinate maps); isomorphism is not graph equality, so #567's literal G = Q_3 and X226's tnth coordinates keep their carriers. No positive-dimension guard.

product-view.note: Fixpoint Q_0 = 'K_1, Q_(d+1) = cartesian_product 'K_2 Q_d on the nested ordinal/product carrier; equal to GTBase.hypercubes.product_hypercube d as a graph record, by induction on d

tuple-view.note: SGraph over d.-tuple bool with exactly one differing coordinate; the same carrier and pointwise adjacency as GTBase.hypercubes.tuple_hypercube d and the identity isomorphism (hypercube_diso), not an equation between opaque proof fields
